name: mini-galaxy-pv-v2
description: Lightweight proxy voting on Polygon Amoy: one VoteEvent contract per event, Neon snapshots, one Render web service with a durable Neon job runner, Reown AppKit, and dApp-triggered MetaMask Snap communications.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace ./packages/contracts && npm run test --workspace ./packages/shared
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:web && npm run build:snap
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:imports && npm run check:structure && npm run audit:architecture && npm run compile && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run build:snap
